scope: Affixes with alvl > 71; AutoMagic is reported but remains deferred.

formula.normal: Let i=max(ilvl,qlvl). If magic_lvl>0: alvl=min(99,i+magic_lvl). Otherwise if i<99-floor(qlvl/2): alvl=i-floor(qlvl/2), else alvl=2*i-99.
formula.drops: Drop accessibility depends on the dropped base qlvl, monster/item ilvl and eligible item types.
formula.crafts: Craft output ilvl and the base qlvl determine alvl; ilvl 71 guarantees four craft affixes but does not itself guarantee every alvl>71 affix.
formula.rerolls: The reroll recipe determines output ilvl; qlvl and magic_lvl still participate in alvl.
formula.gambling: Gambled ilvl varies around character level; base upgrades and qlvl affect the resulting alvl.

limitations: This report proves table eligibility and three-way differences.
It does not claim complete drop/craft/reroll/gambling reachability without a governed acquisition-path simulation for every eligible base.
No gameplay change is authorized by this classification.
